plain: A podcast guest named Jay Anderson says that Jimmy Savile, a famous British television personality, was so influential that he spent his Christmases at Chequers, the country house where the British prime minister spends the holiday. Anderson ties this to a story about Savile and a hospital key, told as an example of how much access powerful people gave him over the decades.
